en: The Verse of the Elder Nun Sumanā, Who Went Forth in Old Age I was born into a wealthy family, Possessing great wealth and abundant grain. My father and mother, out of compassion for me, Gave me whatever I desired. But when I saw the Blessed One, the Fully Awakened One, With his pure and stainless mind, I went forth into homelessness under the Buddha, The Teacher who has crossed over the flood. Having gone forth, I am now free from suffering; I have attained the state of peace. I have reached the end of birth and death; Now there will be no further existence.
“May you be happy, O elder woman,
having covered yourself with this cloth;
for your passion has indeed been stilled.”
“You have become cool and attained Nibbāna.
… [Thus spoke] the elder nun Sumanā, who had gone forth in old age.
